title: Setup and tools: say which organization features need the enterprise edition, and remove fields that do nothing
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

From a real-user walkthrough of Setup, filed on the maintainer's word: 「以上都同意，立卡」 (2026-11-05). Measured on `main` `b7075d9908`, with the console in dev mode, unless a line says otherwise. Test app scaffolded with `create-objectstack@18.3.0`.

An administrator builds a structure and expects an effect the open edition does not give.

## Items

| # | Where | Observed | Suggestion |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | 业务单元 | The page says it is 「用于划定数据和报表的范围」. `readScope: 'unit'` needs `@objectstack/security-enterprise`; compile refuses it in the open edition with a clear message. Sharing rules naming a business unit do work (measured, including revocation when a member leaves) | Say on the page what it does in this edition |
| 2 | `os validate` | Advisory `security-private-no-readscope` suggests `own_and_reports`, `unit` or `unit_and_below`; a project without the enterprise package then fails to compile on exactly that | Suggest only what this project can use, or name the requirement |
| 3 | Edit organization | 时区 field whose own help says it does not change any date calculation | Remove it, or make it work |
| 4 | Edit organization | 上级组织 and 排序 on a single-organization deployment | Hide when there is one organization |

The compile refusal in row 1 is good and should stay as it is.
